name: Sunrise raft

seo.title: Sunrise Raft, Koh Lanta Mangrove | Secret Travel & Tour
seo.metaDescription: A private wooden raft in the Thung Yee Peng mangrove at dawn, breakfast on board and the sunrise over the hills. Hotel pickup at 04:40. From 3,500 THB.

h1: Sunrise on a private raft in the mangrove
lead: A wooden raft for your group only, out on the Thung Yee Peng mangrove before the sun comes up, with breakfast on board.
promise: Sunrise in the mangrove, breakfast on board

facts.label: Where
facts.value: Thung Yee Peng, east coast of Koh Lanta

options.label: Private raft at sunrise
options.note: On the water by 05:30, breakfast on board. The price covers 1 or 2 people. Each extra person adds 1,500 THB, so a group of 3 pays 5,000 THB. Children from 3 to 9 pay 1,200 THB each.

steps.text: Check-in at Thung Yee Peng pier.
The raft moves off slowly into the mangrove.
Sunrise over the hills, reflected in the water.
Light breakfast on the raft, with coffee and tea, while you watch the monkeys and the birds.
Back at the pier, then the transfer to your hotel.

included: Light breakfast, coffee, tea and snacks on the raft
The raft for your group only

beforeYouBook.pickup: Pickup around 04:40 at your hotel, back at the pier at 07:30.
beforeYouBook.children: The raft is private, for your group only. Children from 3 to 9 have a child rate.

faq.a: Around 04:40, and the raft is back at the pier at 07:30, in time for a second breakfast.

photos.alt: Calm water and the mangrove at Thung Yee Peng at dawn
photos.shot: The mangrove at dawn from the raft.

sources.from: affiches du partenaire du radeau (Sunrise View, Sunset Dinner) et base partenaires, déroulé du programme ; option reprise de la fiche Mangroves (découpage des fiches, décision de Jérémy du 11.11.2026). « 1 to 2 people » retiré de l'affichage, même calcul
